name: Fold 10 impressive origami models
blurb: Ten models memorised, folded cleanly from memory. Origami rewards precision: the difference between a beautiful model and a scruffy one is entirely in the accuracy of the early folds.
gear: A bone folder or a fingernail
steps: Learn the base folds and symbols: valley, mountain, squash, petal, reverse fold, and the preliminary and bird bases.
Fold the classics first: crane, jumping frog, lily, boat, star.
Add harder models: modular sonobe cubes, a dragon, a rose, a tessellation.
Focus on precision — crease sharply, align corners exactly, and never rush the first three folds, which set everything after.
Fold each model repeatedly until you can do it from memory without diagrams.
Learn to teach one to someone else, which exposes every part you only half know.
tips: Errors compound. A 2 mm misalignment on fold three becomes a centimetre by fold twenty.
Crease with a fingernail or bone folder. Soft creases give soft, saggy models.
proof: You fold ten models from memory, cleanly, without referring to any instructions.
